<<CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR, BRIEFLY>>

CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR IS IMPORTANT TO KEEP THE MIRROR CLEAR AND TO MAKE THE BEST POSSIBLE OBSERVATIONS. FIRST, YOU NEED TO REMOVE ANY DEBRIS OR DUST FROM THE MIRROR SURFACE. USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL OR A WET TOWEL WITH A LIGHTLY SOAKED CLEANER. MAKE SURE TO WASH THE TOWEL CAREFULLY TO PREVENT ANY RINSE REMAINS ON THE MIRROR. AFTER WASHING, DRY THE TOWEL AND GENTLY GENTLY WIP THE MIRROR TO REMOVE ANY REMAINING DEBRIS. IT IS BEST TO DO THIS IN A DRY PLACE TO PREVENT ANY WATER FROM GETTING ON THE MIRROR. USE A CLEAN, DRY WIPPER TO GENTLY WIP THE MIRROR. AFTER CLEANING, CHECK THE MIRROR FOR ANY DAMAGE OR IRREGULARITIES. IF ANY ARE FOUND, IT IS BEST TO HAVE IT CLEANED BY A PROFESSIONAL. CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR IS A SIMPLE AND IMPORTANT TASK THAT CAN HELP YOU SEE BETTER AND MORE CLEARLY. ALWAYS USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL OR WIPPER TO CLEAN THE MIRROR.
